contract.dataset: 3 million 512D cosine vectors; SQ8 flat search; HNSW disabled
contract.http_rps_basis: successful HTTP requests / actual elapsed including final drain
contract.measurement_accepted_definition: Correctness, route, CPU-mask/work, ISA, helper provenance, and error gates passed; no throughput target is part of acceptance.
contract.query_qps_basis: successful query members / actual elapsed including final drain
contract.stage_diagnostic_scope: Per-node deltas and mean per node; work/wait counters can overlap and are not additive critical-path latency.
contract.topk_selection_basis: explicit user instruction; no current-build A/B claim
